title: Spain Plans to Move Migrant Children from Ceuta to Mainland
subtitle: The government aims to protect vulnerable minors after thousands crossed the border into the Spanish territory.

summary.en: The Spanish government has announced a plan to move 500 vulnerable migrant children from Ceuta to the mainland. These children arrived in the North African territory during a massive border crossing on July 30. While many migrants have returned to Morocco, hundreds of unaccompanied minors remain in poor conditions. The government is working with child protection agencies to provide better care for these youths. However, the plan faces political opposition from groups that believe the children should be returned to their families.
summary.zh: 西班牙政府宣布了一項計畫，將把五百名處於弱勢的移民兒童從休達轉移至本土。這些兒童是在七月三十日大規模越境事件中抵達這塊北非領土的。雖然許多移民已返回摩洛哥，但仍有數百名無人陪伴的未成年人處於惡劣環境中。政府正與兒童保護機構合作，為這些青少年提供更好的照護。然而，該計畫面臨政治反對，反對者認為這些兒童應被送回家人身邊。

paragraphs.en: The Spanish government has announced a new plan to move 500 vulnerable, unaccompanied migrant children from Ceuta to the Spanish mainland. Ceuta is a Spanish territory located on the coast of North Africa. This decision marks a change in direction for the government, which had previously suggested that most people who entered the territory illegally would be sent back to Morocco.
paragraphs.zh: 西班牙政府宣布了一項新計畫，將把五百名處於弱勢、無人陪伴的移民兒童從休達（Ceuta）轉移至西班牙本土。休達是位於北非海岸的西班牙領土。這項決定標誌著政府政策方向的轉變，此前政府曾暗示，大多數非法進入該領土的人將被遣返回摩洛哥。

paragraphs.en: The situation began on July 30, when approximately 70,000 to 80,000 people crossed into Ceuta in hopes of starting a new life in Europe. While the majority of these individuals have since returned to Morocco, thousands remain in the area. According to The Guardian, hundreds of children have been living on the streets, surviving on food and help provided by local residents. Deutsche Welle (DW) reports that national police identified over 2,000 unaccompanied minors shortly after the border crossing, many of whom have been living in poor, unsanitary conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 這場危機始於七月三十日，當時約有七萬至八萬人越境進入休達，希望能到歐洲展開新生活。雖然這些人中大多數隨後已返回摩洛哥，但仍有數千人滯留在當地。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，數百名兒童一直流落街頭，靠著當地居民提供的食物與援助維生。德國之聲（DW）報導指出，國家警察在越境事件發生後不久，確認了超過兩千名無人陪伴的未成年人，其中許多人一直生活在惡劣且不衛生的環境中。

paragraphs.en: Under Spanish law, the state has a duty of care to protect young, unaccompanied migrants until they turn 18. However, the issue has become a sensitive political topic. On August 13, Interior Minister Fernando Grande-Marlaska stated that those who enter Ceuta or Melilla illegally would be sent back, as Spain and Morocco work together to manage the border. Despite this, the government is now moving forward with a plan to relocate the most vulnerable children, especially girls, to the mainland to ensure their safety.
paragraphs.zh: 根據西班牙法律，國家有責任保護這些無人陪伴的年輕移民，直到他們年滿十八歲為止。然而，此議題已成為敏感的政治話題。八月十三日，內政部長格蘭德-馬拉斯卡（Fernando Grande-Marlaska）表示，非法進入休達或梅利亞（Melilla）的人將被遣返，因為西班牙與摩洛哥正合作管理邊界。儘管如此，政府目前仍推動一項計畫，將最弱勢的兒童（特別是女孩）轉移至本土，以確保他們的安全。

paragraphs.en: To avoid conflict with regional governments, the youth ministry is working with the Ceuta government to create an urgent plan. This plan involves using non-governmental organizations (NGOs) and child protection agencies to take care of the children. By doing this, the government hopes to provide support without needing to transfer legal responsibility to regional authorities. Migration Minister Elma Saiz told the public broadcaster RNE that the "overriding welfare of the children" is the most important goal. Lara Contreras from UNICEF Spain noted that 97 girls, aged 9 to 17, have already been moved to better facilities and will be transferred to the mainland as soon as possible.
paragraphs.zh: 為了避免與地方政府產生衝突，青年部正與休達政府合作制定緊急計畫。該計畫涉及利用非政府組織與兒童保護機構來照顧這些兒童。透過這種方式，政府希望在無需將法律責任轉移給地方當局的情況下提供支援。移民部長賽斯（Elma Saiz）告訴公共廣播電台（RNE），「兒童的最大福祉」是首要目標。聯合國兒童基金會（UNICEF）西班牙分會的康特雷拉斯（Lara Contreras）指出，九十七名九至十七歲的女孩已被轉移至更好的設施，並將儘快被送往本土。

paragraphs.en: This approach has not been welcomed by everyone. The People’s Party, a major political group in Spain, has rejected the government’s plan. Juan Bravo, a spokesperson for the party, argued that the best place for these children is with their families. He questioned why the government is not following the advice of the European Commission, which stated that all irregular migrants, including minors, should be returned to Morocco. The European Commission’s spokesperson on internal affairs, Markus Lammert, confirmed that under European Union law, these migrants should be sent back.
paragraphs.zh: 這種做法並未受到所有人的歡迎。西班牙主要政治團體「人民黨」（People’s Party）拒絕了政府的計畫。該黨發言人布拉沃（Juan Bravo）主張，這些兒童最好的歸宿是與家人團聚。他質疑政府為何不聽從歐盟執委會（European Commission）的建議，該委員會曾表示，所有非正規移民（包括未成年人）都應被遣返回摩洛哥。歐盟執委會負責內部事務的發言人拉默特（Markus Lammert）證實，根據歐盟法律，這些移民應該被遣返。

paragraphs.en: The confusion over these different messages exists because the latest European agreement on immigration has not yet been fully added to Spanish law. Therefore, Spain’s own laws regarding the treatment of unaccompanied minors remain in effect. This legal situation makes it difficult for authorities to decide on the best path forward.
paragraphs.zh: 關於這些不同訊息的混亂之所以存在，是因為最新的歐洲移民協議尚未完全納入西班牙法律。因此，西班牙關於對待無人陪伴未成年人的國內法仍然有效。這種法律現狀使得當局難以決定最佳的處理途徑。

paragraphs.en: As the government prepares for the transfers, the focus remains on the immediate needs of the children. Rubén Pérez Correa, the secretary of state for children, has been in Ceuta to help resolve the situation. Meanwhile, officials are working to organize foster homes and government care for those who will be moved. While the political debate continues, the government maintains that its priority is to protect the children who are currently stuck in Ceuta without their families.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著政府準備進行轉移工作，焦點仍放在兒童的迫切需求上。兒童事務國務秘書柯雷亞（Rubén Pérez Correa）已前往休達協助解決此情況。同時，官員們正致力於為即將被轉移的兒童安排寄養家庭與政府照護。儘管政治辯論仍在持續，政府堅稱其首要任務是保護目前滯留在休達且沒有家人陪伴的兒童。

quiz.question: According to the article, what specific priority has the Spanish government set regarding the relocation of children from Ceuta?

options.A: To ensure all 2,000 minors are moved to the mainland immediately.
options.B: To prioritize the relocation of the most vulnerable children, particularly girls.
options.C: To transfer legal responsibility of the children to regional authorities.
options.D: To return all children to their families in Morocco as recommended by the European Commission.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段末尾與第四段內容，政府計畫將最脆弱的兒童（特別是女孩）轉移至西班牙本土以確保安全。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到的是 500 名兒童，而非全部 2,000 名。選項 C 錯誤，第四段明確提到政府希望在「無需」將法律責任轉移給地方當局的情況下提供支持。選項 D 錯誤，這反而是反對黨（人民黨）的立場，而非政府目前的優先事項。

quiz.question: Why is there a conflict between the Spanish government's actions and the advice given by the European Commission?

options.A: The Spanish government is intentionally ignoring European Union laws to gain political popularity.
options.B: The European Commission has not yet provided any clear guidelines on how to handle child migrants.
options.C: The current Spanish national law regarding child protection has not yet been updated to reflect the latest EU immigration agreements.
options.D: The Spanish government believes that the European Commission does not have the authority to intervene in Ceuta.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第六段，混亂的原因在於最新的歐盟移民協議尚未完全納入西班牙法律，因此西班牙國內關於保護未成年人的法律仍然有效。選項 A 為過度推論，文章並未指出政府是為了政治利益而故意忽視法律。選項 B 錯誤，因為文章提到歐盟發言人已明確表示歐盟法律建議將移民送回。選項 D 文章並未提及，這不是造成衝突的核心法律原因。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the phrase 'overriding welfare' mean in the context of Minister Elma Saiz’s statement?

options.A: The most important or dominant concern above all others.
options.B: A secondary issue that can be ignored for now.
options.C: A legal process that involves multiple government departments.
options.D: A feeling of exhaustion caused by caring for too many people.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在文中，Minister Elma Saiz 強調兒童的「overriding welfare」是首要目標，overriding 在此處意指「凌駕於一切之上的」、「最重要的」。選項 B 與原意相反。選項 C 將此詞彙誤解為法律程序，但它描述的是一種優先級。選項 D 將 welfare 誤解為照顧過程中的疲勞感，而非其本意「福祉」。

quiz.question: What is the central focus of this article?

options.A: The historical background of the Spanish territory of Ceuta and its border disputes with Morocco.
options.B: The logistical challenges of organizing foster homes for thousands of migrants in Spain.
options.C: The political and legal complexities surrounding the Spanish government's plan to protect and relocate vulnerable child migrants.
options.D: The failure of the European Commission to provide financial support for the crisis in Ceuta.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文的核心圍繞在西班牙政府如何處理 Ceuta 的無人陪伴未成年移民，包括其政策轉變、面臨的法律衝突（歐盟法與國內法）以及政治上的爭議。選項 A 僅是背景資訊，非文章主旨。選項 B 僅為細節描述，未涵蓋政治爭議。選項 D 文章完全未提到歐盟缺乏資金支持，因此錯誤。
